name: video_compress
description: Make a video file smaller. Give target_size_mb to hit a size limit (for example 25 for Discord, 16 for WhatsApp, 10 for email); it uses two-pass encoding to get as close as possible with the best quality. Otherwise quality high/medium/low picks a size/quality balance. max_height (e.g. 720) lowers the resolution for big savings; codec h265 is ~40% smaller but less widely supported.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

target_size_mb.description: Target file size in megabytes. Uses two-pass encoding.

quality.description: Without a target size: high, medium (default) or low.

max_height.description: Scale down to at most this many pixels high, e.g. 720 or 480.

audio_bitrate.description: Audio bitrate such as 96k or 128k. Default 128k.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. mp4 (default), mkv or mov. Default: next to the input as <name>_compressed.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
